title: Adjunct Lecturer in Public Policy
bio: Jeeyang Rhee Baum is Adjunct Lecturer in Public Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, where she is a Faculty Affiliate with the Ash Center for Democratic Governance and Innovation. Her research and teaching focuses on comparative political institutions, governance, and democratization with particular emphasis on East Asia.
research_interests: Politics Democracy & Governance Development & Economic Growth
